subject: mathematics
concept: Understanding ratio as a comparison between two quantities
source_inspiration: adapted from Singapore CPA sequencing principles — original content, not copied text

exercise.concrete: Student groups two sets of virtual objects and states the comparison in words
exercise.pictorial: Student writes the ratio shown by two pictured groups of objects
exercise.abstract: Student writes a ratio in the form a:b from a written description

misconception_flags: reverses the order of the two quantities in the ratio

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
